title: Maximum Possible Number by Binary Concatenation
summary: Given an array of three integers, return the largest number possible by concatenating their binary representations in any order, ensuring no leading zeros in the binary format.
statement: Given an array of three integers, return the largest number possible by concatenating their binary representations in any order, ensuring no leading zeros in the binary format.
constraints: nums contains exactly three integers in 1..127.
Concatenate the ordinary binary representations without leading zeros in any order.
Return the largest resulting base-ten integer.
reference_solution:
def maximum_binary_concatenation(nums):
    from itertools import permutations
    answer=0
    for order in permutations(nums):
        value=0
        for number in order:value=(value<<number.bit_length())|number
        answer=max(answer,value)
    return answer
